purpose: Every front request performs a Queens-stage commerce/procurement need check. NONE is valid and stops commerce routing; OPTIONAL/REQUIRED creates app-specific research tasks.

requirementShape.reason: why this item is needed for this front task

queensPlan.commentsReviews: BRG_032 only for physical goods/product evidence
queensPlan.officialSpecs: required for safety, nutrition, structural, legal, ticket/booking terms or other high-stakes facts
queensPlan.providerOffers: server-side provider adapters; live offer verification required before recommendation
queensPlan.localMap: local availability discovery only; map result alone is not verified price/delivery

routingRules.NONE: continue normal app Queens→Seed→T1/T2 without shopping provider calls
routingRules.PHYSICAL_GOOD: BRG_032→Drive Queens→qualified Seed→domain template→live provider/local comparison→front reason card
routingRules.TICKET_RESERVATION: domain live/official booking provider lane→Queens/Seed; BRG_032 is not used for venue booking reviews
routingRules.DIGITAL_TOOL_SERVICE: connector/tool/service evaluation lane; do not force physical shopping bridge
routingRules.UNKNOWN: hold recommendation and request/derive missing requirement context; do not rank an offer

output.recommendationReason: app-style-specific reason using verified unit/total cost, availability/delivery/booking, repeated qualified signals and task fit
